text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algerians take advantage of campaign for referendum to amend constitution by complaining to senior government officials about corruption and bureaucracy.
- Bomb kills one, wounds 13 in Berrouaghia south of Algiers.
- Armed forces, bedouin begin voting in referendum.
- Prime Minister Ouyahia says in campaign rally in western city of Oran that Algeria has started paying back first instalments of foreign debt.
- Opposition leaders in Brussels call for peace in Algeria.
- Government sets up council for education.
- Moderate opposition leader Noureddine Boukhrouh says his party urges supporters to endorse draft constitution with aim of bringing rule of law to Algeria.
